traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and requirements for story 010.3-DEV-MIGRATE-TO-SUPPORTS are now implemented and verified. The plugin exposes `prefer-supports-annotation` as the canonical rule name while preserving `prefer-implements-annotation` as a deprecated alias, with appropriate metadata and documentation. The rule provides configurable, default-off recommendations, conservative auto-fix from `@story` + `@req` to `@supports` for single-story cases, detects mixed and multi-story patterns that cannot be auto-fixed, preserves JSDoc structure and formatting, and leaves both annotation formats fully valid when the rule is disabled. Tests for aliasing, behavior, auto-fix, multi-story detection, configuration severity, and documentation all pass, so this story is assessed as PASSED despite the unchecked checkbox remaining in the story markdown.
